name: c-color-picker-1
title: Inline color panel
label: Inline Panel
description: Saturation area, hue and opacity sliders, format fields and preset swatches rendered in place.

guidance.bestFor: The default panel left open in a card, with opacity and 8 presets switched on through 2 root props

whenNotToUse.when: A compact settings row where the controls open only on demand

name: c-color-picker-2
title: Popover picker
label: Popover
description: Outline trigger in a labelled field that opens the full picker with an eye dropper and format fields.

guidance.bestFor: A root with no children, so it draws its own trigger and popover, uncontrolled from a default value in a Field

whenNotToUse.when: People who know the code already and would rather type or paste it

name: c-color-picker-3
title: Color input
label: Color Input
description: Typable field that reads hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or a CSS name, with a swatch that opens the picker.

guidance.bestFor: Typed color codes in an uncontrolled ColorPickerInput, whose swatch button opens the default popover

whenNotToUse.when: A required value that posts with a native form and shows an error

name: c-color-picker-4
title: Opacity
label: Opacity
description: A banner overlay with an opacity slider and field, written as rgb() with alpha.

guidance.bestFor: A translucent scrim laid over a gradient banner and previewed live through an inline style

name: c-color-picker-5
title: Preset swatches
label: Preset Swatches
description: Round label colors to pick from, a plus that opens the full picker, and a live label preview.

guidance.bestFor: An issue label editor with 9 named preset chips, a custom color fallback and Badge ink chosen for contrast
agentNotes: `custom` compares `color` with each `LABEL_COLORS` value as a string, and the picker writes lowercase hex, so keep the presets lowercase

whenNotToUse.when: Toolbar palettes that close on a pick and offer no custom shade

name: c-color-picker-6
title: OKLCH theme token
label: OKLCH Token
description: Lightness, chroma and hue sliders for a --primary token, with a live Button and Badge preview.

guidance.bestFor: A theme token editor in OKLCH that flags colors outside sRGB and prints the CSS line, its copy button taking the bare value
agentNotes: `theme` re-points the primary tokens on the preview row only; write `primary` into your theme stylesheet to restyle the app
`ColorPickerCopy` beside the CSS line copies only the oklch value, not the whole declaration the field shows

name: c-color-picker-7
title: Format converter
label: Format Converter
description: One color as HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB and OKLCH, each with a copy button.

guidance.bestFor: A custom readout built on useColorPicker and formatColor that moves beside the area once its card is wide enough
agentNotes: `FormatList` reads the color through `useColorPicker`, so it must render inside `ColorPicker` or it throws

name: c-color-picker-8
title: Hue wheel
label: Hue Wheel
description: A hue ring around a saturation and brightness square, with HEX, RGB and HSL fields.

guidance.bestFor: A ring layout for a brush, with the area filling the wheel's hole and the format menu cut to 3 entries

name: c-color-picker-9
title: Recent colors
label: Recent Colors
description: Each pick is saved to a Recent row once a drag is released, not on every move.

guidance.bestFor: A hand composed popover whose history row dedupes picks and keeps the latest 8, newest first
agentNotes: `recent` starts as 4 sample colors in `useState` and resets on reload; store it per user to keep the history

name: c-color-picker-10
title: Text and highlight colors
label: Text & Highlight
description: Editor toolbar buttons with preset palettes and a way back to the default color.

guidance.bestFor: A pair of ghost icon triggers whose underline bar mirrors the choice, each palette closing on a pick via controlled open state
agentNotes: The toolbar only restyles a static paragraph from `ink` and `highlight`; route both to your editor's text color and highlight commands
A `null` in `ink` or `highlight` means the default ink or no highlight, which `ColorPickerClear` sets

whenNotToUse.when: A palette that must also accept any shade beyond its presets

name: c-color-picker-11
title: Channel sliders
label: Channel Sliders
description: Red, green, blue and opacity sliders with numeric fields, each track redrawn from the others.

guidance.bestFor: Channel by channel RGB mixing headed by a round preview chip and the live rgb string in monospace

whenNotToUse.when: Perceptual lightness, chroma and hue tracks for a theme token

name: c-color-picker-12
title: Design inspector
label: Design Inspector
description: Fill, stroke and shadow rows that open a compact picker with vertical hue and opacity tracks.

guidance.bestFor: A card of 3 independent, uncontrolled pickers whose triggers print the hex apart from its opacity percent
agentNotes: Each row is uncontrolled through `defaultValue` from `PROPERTIES`; pass `value` and `onValueChange` to read edits back

name: c-color-picker-13
title: Contrast checker
label: Contrast Checker
description: Text and background pickers with a live preview, the WCAG ratio and AA and AAA results.

guidance.bestFor: A swappable pair of default pickers scored by getContrastRatio against 3 WCAG thresholds for body and large text

name: c-color-picker-14
title: Brand scale
label: Brand Scale
description: 11 shades from 50 to 950 generated in OKLCH from one base color, copied as CSS variables.

guidance.bestFor: One typed base color expanded into a palette of standalone ColorPickerSwatch chips, each named for screen readers
agentNotes: `buildScale` pins the base color to step 500 and bends Tailwind blue's `LIGHTNESS` and `CHROMA` curves around it
Copy CSS writes the scale from `css` as hex custom properties with a brand prefix; rename them to your own tokens

name: c-color-picker-15
title: Form field with validation
label: Form Validation
description: Native form field with a required check, an error, reset and the submitted value.

guidance.bestFor: A plain HTML form read through FormData, where the picker posts under name and Field swaps its hint for the error
agentNotes: `onSubmit` only reads `brandColor` from `FormData` into local `saved` state; send it to your API there
